title: Efficiency Mode and Driving Efficiency
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise efficient driving behavior, good fuel or battery economy, and preference for using efficiency mode, while a few comments are unclear or note weak battery efficiency.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the vehicle as efficient, praise fuel or charge economy, and often express a preference to drive in efficiency mode or keep it as the default.

negative.summary: The negative review says battery use is not very efficient.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention efficiency improvement or confusion about differences between modes without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: The sampled fragments focus on several related but distinct ideas, including fuel economy, battery efficiency, range behavior, and questions about drive modes.
Undetermined examples are limited, so the reason for unclear sentiment is only partially evidenced.
The examples are a stratified sample and do not represent the full distribution of all reviews.
